name: Morrison R. Waite High School (1914), 301 Morrison Dr
refs: refs/w8000128844/00 (Waite High School Toledo (Cropped), July 2022, Wikimedia Commons)
notes: Jacobethan in dark red brick with limestone trim: four storeys of grouped mullioned windows, a tall central gabled pavilion with a great window flanked by turreted stone towers facing Morrison Dr, crenellated stone parapets.
